=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21272-21286 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_heal_counterfactual_hold_expiry_check` closes the issue (PATCH `state=closed`, `state_reason=not_planned`) before it posts the `ai:heal-counterfactual-hold-expired:v1` marker; a failed post only emits a `::warning::`, the function still records `outcome="expired"`, and nothing retries the post.
  WHY: The expired marker is the only reopen guard (`expired_present` leads to `kept reason=reopened`). If a maintainer reopens an issue that has no marker, the next tick sees the old hold and escalation markers still qualify and closes the issue again, which breaks the "a reopened issue is never closed again" contract; minimax also notes `test_failed_expired_comment_only_warns` pins the buggy behaviour. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21191-21213, 21272-21274 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The function looks for maintainer answers in the supplied comment snapshot, then closes the issue without checking for answers posted after that snapshot was fetched.
  WHY: A maintainer `/approved`, `/reclarify` or `/answer` posted between the snapshot read and the PATCH is missed, and the poller closes the issue anyway.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21205-21209 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The human-answer filter excludes only `[auto-answered-by-` and `_Orchestrator stall recovery` bodies. Standalone stall-recovery posts (`/reclarify` at line 29122, `/answer` at line 29174, `/approved` at lines 29216, 29266 and 29499, all with "_Standalone stall recovery: ...") are not excluded.
  WHY: When the pipeline login is the repository OWNER, those posts count as maintainer answers, so `outcome=kept reason=answered` and the hold never escalates or expires, which contradicts "auto-answers and stall-recovery posts do not count". Rated NIT.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:822-829 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `[ "${guard_files_total}" -ge 20 ]` fires at exactly the `FAILING_TEST_LIMIT = 20` cap (`scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4634`), so every capped run returns `outcome=keep reason=files_truncated` and the target-files guard is silenced.
  WHY: Runs with exactly 20 failing files never reach the cat-file checks and never clear the route; the suggested fix is `-gt "${FAILING_TEST_LIMIT:-20}"`. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly rejected this finding: they say the file is not in this PR, and that keeping the route at the cap is the correct fail-open direction.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:lines 334-344 in `tests/test_check_failure_triage_target_files_guard.py` | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new test only covers the helper returning 25 items, never exactly 20, even though 20 is the helper cap that every capped run returns.
  WHY: Without a 20-item case the line-826 off-by-one (`-ge 20` firing at the cap) is untested, so a regression could pass CI. Rated MAJOR.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:822-829 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `PR_CHECK_RUNS_CONTEXT_FILE` is absent or empty, `guard_files_total` is non-numeric and the guard logs `reason=files_truncated`, where it previously logged `reason=no_failing_files`.
  WHY: The outcome (`keep`) is unchanged, but the reason token drifts, so log analysis keyed to `no_failing_files` for the empty-context case no longer sees it. Rated NIT.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:536-542 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `git add -- "${github_ai_grant_path}" >/dev/null 2>&1` swallows all stderr, so permission, corruption, gitignore and TOCTOU failures all show up as the same `outcome=refused reason=add_failed`.
  WHY: Operators cannot diagnose why a granted `.github/ai/` path failed to stage, and the commit goes ahead with incomplete staged content. Both reviewers rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected it as out of this PR's diff.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Deliver exactly the Phase 7 scope from the plan as one independently mergeable, production-safe PR. Do not pull in work from other phases." / "Touch only the files the plan lists for Phase 7" (issue #9986 `files_touched` grant)
  expected_change_site: The last-run diff should modify only granted Phase 7 paths; it should not have edited `scripts/check_failure_triage.sh` or `scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh`.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The last-run diff modifies `scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:822-829` (Phase 2 #9823 `files_truncated` guard) and `scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:536-542` (Phase 5 #9920 `outcome=refused reason=add_failed` branch). Neither file is in the Phase 7 plan list (`docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md` Phase 7, lines 451-460) or in the `files_touched` grant. luna also lists `tests/test_check_failure_triage_target_files_guard.py`, `tests/test_github_ai_plan_grant_write.py` and `agents.d/9823-red-main-heal-dedupe.md`; minimax and glm say those are covered by the `tests/**` and `agents.d/*` globs. `changelog.d/9986-counterfactual-hold-expiry.md` documents neither behaviour change. Rated BLOCKER by gemini, minimax and luna, MAJOR by glm. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this gap: neither file is in the PR's changed-file list, which has exactly the 8 Phase 7 files, so the diff shows base drift.
- requirement: "Every Phase 7 acceptance criterion in the plan is met" / Phase 7 item 2: prefer `_resolve_linked_pr_fresh_by_branch`, then a cross-referenced PR passing `_linked_pr_is_issue_implementation`, then the last cross-reference; skip docs-only candidates.
  expected_change_site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` `_stall_judge_resolve_linked_pr`, around the docs-only skip and the last-xref fallback
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The function uses `_pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr` (lines 24064-24065 / 24099-24100), which accepts closing keywords, rather than the plan-named `_linked_pr_is_issue_implementation`. The docs-only skip is at lines 24076-24086. The `agents.d/9986-counterfactual-hold-expiry.md` paragraph 1 matches the code but differs from the plan text. Rated NIT.
- requirement: "Existing tests still pass." / acceptance gate evidence
  expected_change_site: The PR's pre-push test gate section (PR description) and CI check-runs
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR body reports the gate as unverified: 0 tests run, `container_rc_137` (SIGKILL, consistent with an OOM). No test evidence exists for the six acceptance targets; only the in-progress `review / codex-agent` and `quick / static-checks` checks are pending. Rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_heal_counterfactual_hold_expiry_check, lines 21272-21285 (reopen guard at line 21228) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The check closes the issue first and treats a failed post of the `ai:heal-counterfactual-hold-expired:v1` marker as a warning; it still records `expired` and never retries the post.
  WHY: A reopened issue has no expired marker, while the old hold and escalation markers still qualify, so the next tick closes it again. Suggested fix: retry the post, and if it still fails, PATCH `state=open` and report `close_failed`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_heal_counterfactual_hold_expiry_check, answer filter at lines 21205-21209 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The filter does not exclude standalone stall-recovery `/reclarify` (line 29122), `/answer` (line 29174) or `/approved` (lines 29216, 29266, 29499) posts.
  WHY: When the pipeline login is OWNER, those posts set `$answered`, so the result is `outcome=kept reason=answered` and the hold never escalates or expires. Suggested fix: exclude `_Standalone stall recovery`.
- NOTE: Rejected pass-1 items: the out-of-scope task gap for scripts/check_failure_triage.sh and scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh (not in the PR's changed-file list; base drift at scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:780-827); `-ge 20` at scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:826 (out of PR; documented fail-open); stderr NITs in scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh (out of PR). Verified as correct: the comment snapshot (lines 20851-20870, 20692-20714), `_linked_prs_by_branch_name` (line 5155), `_pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr` usage (line 25414), the CI step (ci.yml:1813) and `_run_bash` (tests/test_stall_recovery_pr_lookup.py:37). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2.
